name: Nobody (spam & ads)
role: Not for anyone here: advertising, spam and scams
responsibilities: Product advertising and sales offers from other companies|Newsletters and mass marketing emails|Prize, lottery, reward and gift card scams|The scam or phishing email itself, asking to click a link or log in (not a colleague reporting one)|Get-rich, crypto investment and loan offers|Fake invoices or payment requests from unknown senders
example_emails: Buy our new ergonomic chairs with 40% off this week only!|You have been selected for a 1000 EUR reward, click to claim.|Subscribe to our weekly marketing tips newsletter.|Dear customer, verify your account now or it will be closed.|Invest in our new coin and double your money in a week.|Ekskluzivna ponudba samo danes: brezplačna dostava za vse izdelke!

name: Nobody (personal)
role: Not for anyone here: personal or private matters
responsibilities: Personal life, family, friends and pets|Health, doctors, dentists and private appointments|Private buying and selling of items like cars, bikes or furniture|Restaurants, food orders, private shopping and holidays|Weather, hobbies, gossip and small talk
example_emails: Hey, how was your weekend at the lake?|Selling my old bike, anyone interested?|Can I book a haircut for Saturday?|Kje je najboljša pica v mestu?|Moj pes je spet zbolel, kaj naj naredim?

name: Nobody (wrong recipient)
role: Not for anyone here: wrong recipient or another company's business
responsibilities: Emails clearly meant for another company or person|Customer orders, returns, sizes and deliveries for shops and products we do not sell|Questions about services we do not offer|Complaints about other companies' products
example_emails: I think I sent this to the wrong address, sorry.|My shoe order arrived in the wrong size, how do I return it?|Do you deliver flowers to Ljubljana?|When does your store open on Sundays?|Vaš izdelek se je pokvaril po enem tednu, zahtevam vračilo denarja.
